readings: Using a strict cutoff, take advanced behaviour records with patsim greater than 0.439 and match each to its transaction record where transactionrecord.transreg equals advancedbehavior.translink, dropping records with no match. For each ordertypedist value, with missing values as their own group, show the order type mix and the number of matched records.

Using an inclusive cutoff, take advanced behaviour records with patsim greater than or equal to 0.439 and match each to its transaction record where transactionrecord.transreg equals advancedbehavior.translink, dropping records with no match. For each ordertypedist value, with missing values as their own group, show the order type mix and the number of matched records.
queries:
SELECT t.ordertypedist, COUNT(*) AS matched_records
FROM advancedbehavior a
INNER JOIN transactionrecord t ON t.transreg = a.translink
WHERE a.patsim > 0.439
GROUP BY t.ordertypedist

SELECT t.ordertypedist, COUNT(*) AS matched_records
FROM advancedbehavior a
JOIN transactionrecord t ON t.transreg = a.translink
WHERE a.patsim >= 0.439
GROUP BY t.ordertypedist;
